name: Screensaver Agenda
description: Shows upcoming events from one or more Home Assistant calendars in a corner or along an edge of the screensaver, over Immich photos or any other mode, laid out like Calendar Card Pro with a color per calendar. It reads the calendars through Kiosk Satellite's own Home Assistant connection, so it needs no token or helper sensor. The card is visual only: touches pass through and still dismiss the screensaver.
author: jtscott

settings.title: Calendars
settings.description: The calendars to show, each with its own name, icon and accent color. Up to 6.

fields.title: Name
fields.description: Shown after each event's time, in this calendar's color. Empty for none.

fields.title: Icon
fields.description: Shown before each event's title, in this calendar's color. Empty for none.

fields.title: Color
fields.description: The accent bar, name and icon color.

settings.title: Title
settings.description: Shown above the events. Leave empty for no title.

settings.title: Days ahead
settings.description: Show events starting within this many days, today included.

settings.title: Maximum events
settings.description: The most events listed at once.

settings.title: Show location
settings.description: Add each event's location on its own line under the time.

settings.title: Clock format
settings.description: How event times are written.

settings.title: Date column
settings.description: Weekday, day and month beside each day's events. Off shows a Today, Tomorrow or date heading above them instead.

settings.title: Date alignment
settings.description: How the weekday, day and month line up in the date column.

settings.title: Accent bar
settings.description: A line beside each event in its calendar's color.

settings.title: Show end time
settings.description: 6:30 PM - 8:00 PM instead of 6:30 PM.

settings.title: Clock icon
settings.description: An icon before the time, and before the location when it shows.

settings.title: Relative time
settings.description: How far off each event is on the right: now, in 5 hours, tomorrow, in 2 days.

settings.title: Title lines
settings.description: Long titles wrap to this many lines, then end with an ellipsis.

settings.title: Title
settings.description: The title above the events.

settings.title: Weekday
settings.description: Wed in the date column.

settings.title: Day number
settings.description: 21 in the date column.

settings.title: Month
settings.description: OCT in the date column.

settings.title: Day heading
settings.description: Today, Tomorrow or the date above each day.

settings.title: Event title
settings.description: Each event's name.

settings.title: Time and location
settings.description: The time and location lines. Their icons follow this size.

settings.title: Relative time
settings.description: now, in 5 hours, tomorrow on the right.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Where this card sits. It is not a Kiosk Satellite widget, so Settings > Screensaver > Widgets does not place it. Pick a spot those widgets leave empty.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: Scales the whole card, text sizes included.

settings.title: Background opacity
settings.description: How dark the card behind the text is. 0 draws text only.
